mapper.sql: SELECT history.group_jid AS groupJid, COALESCE( MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), '')), MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(handle.group_name), '')), MAX(history.baseline_subject) ) AS subject, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(current_invite.invite_code), '')) AS inviteCode, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(legacy_preview.owner_phone), '')) AS ownerPhone, MAX(CASE WHEN current_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE FLOOR(current_profile.wa_created_at / 1000) END) AS groupCreatedAt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relation.presence_status <> 0 THEN relation.id END) AS knownMembershipCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN relation.presence_status = 1 THEN relation.id END) AS inGroupCount, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.presence_status = 1 AND relation.role IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adminInGroup, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.presence_status = 1 AND REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(relation.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ownerInGroup, MAX(current_profile.announce_only) AS announceOnly, COALESCE(MAX(current_profile.checked_member_count), MAX(current_profile.member_count)) AS memberSize, MAX(CASE WHEN relation.presence_status = 1 AND relation.role IN (2, 3) AND relation.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND relation.account_state IN #{executableState} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS operable FROM ( SELECT baseline_group.id AS group_id, baseline_group.group_jid, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(baseline_binding.baseline_subject_snapshot), '')) AS baseline_subject FROM account a0 INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding baseline_binding ON baseline_binding.tenant_id = a0.tenant_id AND baseline_binding.account_id = a0.id AND baseline_binding.was_in_initial_baseline = 1 INNER JOIN wa_group baseline_group ON baseline_group.tenant_id = baseline_binding.tenant_id AND baseline_group.id = baseline_binding.group_id WHERE a0.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a0.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a0.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY baseline_group.id, baseline_group.group_jid ) history LEFT JOIN ( SELECT binding.id, binding.group_id, participant.presence_status, participant.role, a1.ws_phone, s1.login_state, s1.account_state FROM account a1 INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = a1.tenant_id AND binding.account_id = a1.id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant participant ON participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND participant.id = binding.participant_id LEFT JOIN account_state s1 ON s1.tenant_id = a1.tenant_id AND s1.account_id = a1.id WHERE a1.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a1.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a1.deleted_at IS NULL ) relation ON relation.group_id = history.group_id LEFT JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND handle.group_id = history.group_id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_profile.group_id = history.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite current_invite ON current_invite.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_invite.id = COALESCE( handle.group_invite_id, current_profile.current_invite_id) GROUP BY history.group_id, history.group_jid

) grouped_history WHERE knownMembershipCount = 0 OR adminInGroup = 1

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM account a INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND binding.account_id = a.id AND binding.was_in_initial_baseline = 1 INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} )

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, TRUE AS groupAdmin FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 AND self_participant.role IN (2, 3) INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.account_group_id = #{accountGroupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state IN #{executableState} ORDER BY CASE WHEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, TRUE AS groupAdmin FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 AND self_participant.role IN (2, 3) INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN group_link handle ON handle.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND handle.group_id = binding.group_id AND handle.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_link_preview legacy_preview ON legacy_preview.tenant_id = handle.tenant_id AND legacy_preview.group_link_id = handle.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id <> #{managerAccountId} AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state IN #{executableState} AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.ws_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(legacy_preview.owner_phone, '@', 1), '+', '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, CASE WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS groupAdmin FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.id <> #{managerAccountId} AND a.protocol_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_id) <> '' AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) <> '' AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state IN #{executableState} AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND s.mute_status IS NULL ORDER BY a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT binding.account_id AS accountId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, CASE self_participant.presence_status WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN CASE self_participant.last_exit_type WHEN 'REMOVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ELSE 2 END AS membershipStatus, COALESCE(self_participant.presence_observed_at, binding.last_observed_at) AS statusUpdatedAt FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id WHERE (binding.account_id, current_group.group_jid) IN
(#{lookup.accountId}, #{lookup.groupJid})

SELECT binding.account_id AS accountId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, CASE WHEN self_participant.presence_status <> 1 THEN NULL WHEN current_profile.announce_only = 0 THEN TRUE WHEN current_profile.announce_only = 1 AND self_participant.role IN (2, 3) THEN TRUE WHEN current_profile.announce_only = 1 AND self_participant.role = 1 THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END AS messageSendAllowed FROM wa_account_group_binding binding INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_group.id = binding.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND current_profile.group_id = binding.group_id WHERE (binding.account_id, current_group.group_jid) IN
(#{lookup.accountId}, #{lookup.groupJid})
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, CASE WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS groupAdmin FROM group_link group_handle INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = group_handle.tenant_id AND binding.group_id = group_handle.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id AND self_participant.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND a.id = binding.account_id AND (a.owner_user_id = group_handle.owner_user_id OR (a.owner_user_id IS NULL AND group_handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND a.protocol_account_id != '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND a.ws_phone != '' INNER JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND s.account_id = a.id AND s.login_state = #{onlineLoginState} AND s.account_state IN #{executableState} LEFT JOIN group_link_preview owner_preview ON owner_preview.tenant_id = group_handle.tenant_id AND owner_preview.group_link_id = group_handle.id WHERE group_handle.id = #{groupLinkId} AND group_handle.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: ORDER BY CASE WHEN self_participant.role IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, binding.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

AND owner_preview.owner_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(owner_preview.owner_phone) <> '' AND REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(a.ws_phone), '@', 1), '+', '') = REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(owner_preview.owner_phone), '@', 1), '+', '') ORDER BY COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, binding.id ASC LIMIT 1
AND self_participant.role IN (2, 3) ORDER BY COALESCE(binding.last_observed_at, 0) DESC, binding.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT controlled_account.id AS accountId, group_handle.id AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, MAX(CASE WHEN member.role IN (2, 3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS admin FROM group_link group_handle INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = group_handle.tenant_id AND current_group.id = group_handle.group_id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant member ON member.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND member.group_id = current_group.id AND member.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account controlled_account ON controlled_account.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND controlled_account.ws_phone = member.phone AND (controlled_account.owner_user_id = group_handle.owner_user_id OR (controlled_account.owner_user_id IS NULL AND group_handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) AND controlled_account.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE group_handle.id = #{groupLinkId} AND group_handle.deleted_at IS NULL AND member.phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(member.phone) <> '' GROUP BY controlled_account.id, group_handle.id, current_group.group_jid ORDER BY controlled_account.id ASC

SELECT controlled_account.id AS accountId, controlled_account.protocol_id AS protocolId, controlled_account.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, controlled_account.ws_phone AS wsPhone, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(member.pn_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(member.lid_jid), '')) AS participantJid, member.role AS role, controlled_state.login_state AS loginState, controlled_state.account_state AS accountState, binding.membership_active_since_at AS membershipActiveSinceAt FROM group_link group_handle INNER JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = group_handle.tenant_id AND current_group.id = group_handle.group_id INNER JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = current_group.tenant_id AND binding.group_id = current_group.id INNER JOIN wa_group_participant member ON member.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND member.group_id = binding.group_id AND member.id = binding.participant_id AND member.presence_status = 1 INNER JOIN account controlled_account ON controlled_account.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id AND controlled_account.id = binding.account_id AND (controlled_account.owner_user_id = group_handle.owner_user_id OR (controlled_account.owner_user_id IS NULL AND group_handle.owner_user_id IS NULL)) AND controlled_account.deleted_at IS NULL AND controlled_account.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(controlled_account.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND controlled_account.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(controlled_account.ws_phone) <> '' LEFT JOIN account_state controlled_state ON controlled_state.tenant_id = controlled_account.tenant_id AND controlled_state.account_id = controlled_account.id WHERE group_handle.id = #{groupLinkId} AND group_handle.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY controlled_account.id ASC
